description:
You are logged into wger fitness manager at http://localhost as admin (username: admin, password: adminadmin). Your company, Apex Manufacturing, is launching a 12-week corporate wellness challenge. A briefing document has been placed at /home/ga/Documents/wellness_challenge_brief.txt with all participant details and program requirements.

Read the briefing document carefully and complete ALL of the following:
1. Register the three employee accounts listed in the briefing document as members of the Default gym (gym ID 1)
2. Create each employee's personalized workout routine exactly as specified in the briefing
3. Create the measurement tracking category specified in the briefing
4. Create the team nutrition plan described in the briefing

All names, usernames, and values must match the briefing document exactly.
